correctness.rationale: For every integer N>=3, occupancy 0<phi<1, persistent rate a>0, unbiased hopping rate d>=0 and reversal r>0, differentiating the specified factorized nonlinear dynamics yields an exact 2x2 Bloch symbol. Its trace is negative for each nonconstant mode, and its determinant is q times a real affine function of q=1-cos k for phi>1/2; for phi<=1/2 the determinant is directly positive. Therefore the first nonzero harmonic controls instability, and expansion gives exactly the explicit quadratic activity inequality. Its positive leading coefficient characterizes the existence of a positive activity threshold; the quadratic root, N<=4 no-go, sharp N=5 density barrier, and inverse-square ring-size shift follow algebraically. The standalone Python 3 checker, independently differentiating the nonlinear equations with Fourier perturbations and checking finite parameter sets, passed 4,917 deterministic assertions. These numerical checks supplement but do not replace the analytic proof. At equality a mode is marginal; no nonlinear or stochastic phase-transition claim is made.

originality.rationale: The 2026 motivating source supplies the general Bloch eigenproblem and its infinite-lattice small-wave-number spinodal; its accessible main-text excerpt explicitly treats finite-lattice stability numerically. The new theorem solves all discrete wave numbers for the one-dimensional ring, gives a sharp closed activity criterion for every N, the density-only obstruction through N=4 and first N=5 onset, and the positive inverse-square ring-size finite-size correction. At N=5 and occupancy 3/4 the infinite-volume criterion predicts instability at high activity but the finite ring remains stable for all activity, so the infinite long-wave condition does not imply the exact finite result. No matching explicit theorem was found in the cited relevant literature or available published-record comparisons, but the motivating full main text and some related full texts were inaccessible, leaving genuine residual priority risk.

Full texts of some older related active-exclusion works were inaccessible; a hidden equivalent finite-ring theorem or broader spectral-classification corollary remains possible.

value.rationale: The natural finite-size stability question was expressly left to numerical analysis in the motivating model, despite an available infinite-volume long-wave spinodal. The exact finite-ring solution supplies an all-parameter threshold for a primary one-dimensional Bravais-lattice geometry, a sharp four-site obstruction and first five-site realization, and a quantified O(inverse-square ring-size) contraction. For example the infinite threshold predicts growing long waves at density 3/4 whereas a five-site ring forbids them at any activity. This structurally informative finite cutoff is a meaningful physical and mathematical benchmark, not an arbitrary isolated numeric evaluation.
